caption: The drawing shows a classical architectural structure depicted against a light, neutral background. The structure consists of a pediment with diagonal red and light pink stripes resting on four vertical reddish columns with matching bases and capitals, all set atop a rectangular platform. Within the structure's frontal wall is an arched niche shaded in muted gray tones, with its opening facing forward. On either side of the structure, two stylized trees with light blue-green leaves and pale reddish trunks extend upwards above the platform, partially overlapping the background. Beneath the structure is a marbled panel in swirled shades of pink and off-white, covering the lower central section of the composition. The floor at the bottom is illustrated with reddish-brown rectangular tiles, arranged in perspective to suggest depth. The overall palette includes various shades of red, pink, light blue-green, gray, and neutral tones. The artist's signature, "Edith Brower," appears in the lower right corner.
title: Wall Painting: Restoration Drawing
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
